create_Gamma: create a Gamma distribution with concentration and rate parameters from PyTorch tensors
test_Gamma_rsample: test the Gamma distribution rsample method to generate reparameterized random samples
test_Gamma_log_prob: test the Gamma distribution log_prob method to compute log probability of values
test_Gamma_entropy: test the Gamma distribution entropy method to compute differential entropy
test_Gamma_cdf: test the Gamma distribution cdf method to compute cumulative distribution function
